editorial:
Imagine moving into your dream home only to find out it was built on the site of a scary fire from ten years ago. That is exactly what happens to Kyle and Sarah. They are young and excited to start their lives together, but the neighborhood is full of weird rumors about the previous owner who just vanished. The vibe starts off cozy but quickly turns creepy. Once they spend their first night there, things get strange fast. It feels like someone is watching them, and when a close friend suddenly goes missing, you realize this is not just a ghost story. It is a dangerous game of cat-and-mouse where the couple is the prey.

You will probably enjoy how the tension builds up, though the pacing can feel a bit slow in some spots. The acting is solid and makes you care about whether the couple survives the night. If you love mysteries that keep you guessing, you should definitely give this a try. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick if you want something suspenseful but not too heavy.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the mystery is not supernatural at all. It turns out a living person has been hiding in the walls and secret spaces of the house the whole time. This person was obsessed with the property and wanted to torment anyone who moved in. After a tense fight, Kyle and Sarah manage to outsmart the killer. They survive the night and the police finally close the case on the missing people.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy house mysteries and surprise twists.
